polls.note: Palver national poll released on 15/Oct, the pollster's first after the first round, registration BR-08028/2026, 5,000 interviews from 10 to 13/Oct, margin of 2.3pp at 95% confidence, R$ 30 thousand paid with its own funds (Poder360). ⚖️ IN THE SECOND ROUND FLÁVIO BOLSONARO HAS 50% AND LULA 49%, with 1% blank and null votes and no undecided voters. In the 03/Oct wave, on the eve of the first round, it was 49% and 44%.

Indexa national poll released on 15/Oct, commissioned by Estadão/Broadcast, registration BR-04629/2026, 2,000 interviews on 13 and 14/Oct, margin of 2.2pp at 95% confidence, R$ 164 thousand (Poder360 and Estadão). ⚖️ IN THE SECOND ROUND FLÁVIO BOLSONARO HAS 44% AND LULA 42% in total votes, with 8% who say they will not vote, 4% blank and null votes and 2% undecided; in valid votes, 51% to 49%. In the 30/Sep wave, still before the first round, it was 42% for Flávio Bolsonaro and 43% for Lula. The same wave measured 60% in favour of ending the 6x1 work schedule and 30% against, and 50% disapproval of the Lula government.

Quaest national poll released on 14/Oct, the pollster's first after the first round, registration BR-08729/2026, 2,154 in-person interviews with voters aged 16 or older from 10 to 13/Oct, margin of 2pp with 95% confidence, commissioned by Grupo Globo (Metrópoles, Exame and O Globo). ⚖️ IN THE SECOND ROUND FLÁVIO BOLSONARO HAS 46% AND LULA 44% in total votes, with 9% blank and spoiled ballots and 1% undecided. In the 03/Oct wave it was 44% and 42%.

PoderData national poll released on 13/Oct in partnership with Aya, registration BR-01209/2026, 3,000 automated phone interviews from 10 to 12/Oct, margin of 1.8pp with 95% confidence (Jovem Pan and Poder360). ⚖️ IN THE SECOND ROUND FLÁVIO BOLSONARO HAS 48% AND LULA 46% in total votes, with 5% blank and spoiled ballots and 2% who could not answer; in valid votes, 51% to 49%. In the 05 to 07/Oct wave it was 49% to 44% in total votes. 46% say they would not vote for Lula under any circumstances and 44% for Flávio Bolsonaro. The Lula government is disapproved by 50% and approved by 44%.

BTG/Nexus national poll released on 13/Oct, the pollster's first after the first round, registration BR-07997/2026, 2,002 voters by phone from 10 to 12/Oct, margin of 2pp with 95% confidence, commissioned by the bank BTG Pactual (Jovem Pan and CNN Brasil). ⚖️ IN THE SECOND ROUND FLÁVIO BOLSONARO HAS 48% AND LULA 45% in total votes, with 5% blank and spoiled ballots and 2% undecided; in valid votes, 52% to 48%. 51% say they would not vote for Lula under any circumstances and 47% for Flávio Bolsonaro. The Lula government is disapproved by 50% and approved by 45%.

Futura/100% Cidades national poll released on 13/Oct, registration BR-00650/2026, 2,000 voters aged 16 or over by phone from 07 to 10/Oct, margin of 2.2pp with 95% confidence (Transmissão Política, Exame and CNN Brasil). ⚖️ IN THE SECOND ROUND FLÁVIO BOLSONARO HAS 50% AND LULA 46.6% in total votes, with 1.7% blank, spoiled or none and 1.7% who don't know; in valid votes, 51.8% to 48.2%. 48.6% reject Lula and 45.4% reject Flávio Bolsonaro (CNN Brasil).

Gerp national poll released on the night of 12/Oct, with release registered with the TSE for 13/Oct, registration BR-07877/2026, 2,400 voters by phone on 08, 09 and 12/Oct, margin of 2pp with 95.55% confidence, with its own funds (CNN Brasil, Conexão Política and TMC). ⚖️ IN THE SECOND ROUND FLÁVIO BOLSONARO HAS 53% AND LULA 44% in total votes, with 3% who don't know or didn't answer and 1% who would vote for neither; in valid votes, 55% to 45%. The Lula government is disapproved by 49% and approved by 45% (Jovem Pan).

DataTrends national poll released on 11/Oct, the pollster's first in the second round, registration BR-03576/2026, 2,000 voters in automated phone interviews from 07 to 09/Oct, margin of 2.19pp with 95% confidence, R$ 25 thousand from its own funds (Poder360, Diário de São Paulo and GP1). ⚖️ IN THE SECOND ROUND FLÁVIO BOLSONARO HAS 50% AND LULA 44% in total votes, with 5% blank and spoiled ballots and 1% who don't know or didn't answer; in valid votes, 53.1% to 46.9%. The Lula government is disapproved by 53% and approved by 45% (Blog Edmar Lyra).

Ipespe national poll released on 10/Oct, the first wave of the Ipespe/Abrapel Campaign Tracking in the second round, registration BR-00933/2026, 1,500 voters through random digital recruitment from 06 to 08/Oct, margin of 2.6pp with 95.45% confidence (O Globo and Exame). ⚖️ IN THE SECOND ROUND FLÁVIO BOLSONARO HAS 49% AND LULA 44% in total votes, with 5% blank and spoiled ballots and 3% who don't know or didn't answer. In valid votes, Flávio Bolsonaro 52.7% and Lula 47.3%, a calculation the pollster calls an exercise. Among Augusto Cury's voters, Flávio Bolsonaro has 50% and Lula 29%; among Ronaldo Caiado's, 56% to 15%, and the pollster warns that these groups are small in the sample. 47% say they would certainly vote for Flávio Bolsonaro and 46% that they would not vote for him under any circumstances; for Lula, 43% and 49%.

AtlasIntel national poll released on 09/Oct, commissioned by Bloomberg, the pollster's first after the first round, registration BR-03663/2026, 5,026 voters through random digital recruitment from 03 to 08/Oct, margin of 1pp with 95% confidence (Estadão, CNN Brasil and CartaCapital). ⚖️ IN THE SECOND ROUND FLÁVIO BOLSONARO HAS 51.1% AND LULA 45.7% in total votes, and blank ballots, spoiled ballots and undecided voters add up to 3.2%, after 47.6% to 47.4% for Lula in the pollster's round of 03/Oct, conducted before the vote. In valid votes, Flávio Bolsonaro 52.8% and Lula 47.2%. Among Augusto Cury's voters, Lula has 50.4% and Flávio Bolsonaro 38.9%; among Ronaldo Caiado's, Flávio Bolsonaro has 54.9% and Lula 26.9%.

Vox Brasil national poll released on 09/Oct, the pollster's first after the first round, registration BR-09623/2026, 2,100 voters interviewed in person from 05 to 07/Oct, margin of 2.15pp with 95% confidence (CartaCapital, CNN Brasil and Poder360). ⚖️ IN THE SECOND ROUND LULA HAS 44.2% AND FLÁVIO BOLSONARO 42.7%, within the margin, with 3.4% blank and spoiled ballots and 9.7% who do not know, after 48.2% to 45.2% for Flávio Bolsonaro in the pollster's round of 02/Oct, conducted before the vote. In valid votes, Lula 50.86% and Flávio Bolsonaro 49.14%. 76.2% of voters say they are fully decided.

Datafolha national poll released on 08/Oct, the pollster's first after the first round, registration BR-02949/2026, 2,520 voters aged 16 or older interviewed from 06 to 08/Oct, margin of 2pp with 95% confidence (Brasil de Fato, CartaCapital, G1 and Valor). ⚖️ IN THE SECOND ROUND FLÁVIO BOLSONARO HAS 49% AND LULA 45%, after 47% to 46% for Lula in the pollster's round of 03/Oct, conducted before the vote; blank, null and none add up to 5% and undecided 1%. In valid votes, Flávio Bolsonaro 52% and Lula 48%. Rejection: 46% would not vote for Lula and 43% would not vote for Flávio Bolsonaro. The Lula government's rating is negative for 40% and positive for 35%.

PoderData national poll released on 08/Oct in partnership with Aya, the first poll published after the first round, registration BR-08134/2026, 3,000 telephone interviews in 705 municipalities across the 27 federative units, from 05 to 07/Oct, margin of 1.8pp with 95% confidence (Poder360 and Jovem Pan). ⚖️ IN THE SECOND ROUND FLÁVIO BOLSONARO HAS 49% AND LULA 44% in total votes, with 5% blank and spoiled ballots and 2% undecided; in valid votes, 53% to 47%. Among Augusto Cury's voters, Flávio Bolsonaro has 56% and Lula 27%; among Ronaldo Caiado's, 57% to 19%; among Renan Santos's, 48% to 25%; among Romeu Zema's, 72% to 10% (Jovem Pan). On expectation of victory, 54% think Flávio Bolsonaro wins and 37% that Lula wins. Rejection: 46% would not vote for Lula and 43% would not vote for Flávio Bolsonaro (CNN Brasil). 📌 Correction of 09/Oct: on 08/Oct this entry said the release included only valid votes; it also included the total, which has been added here.

Palver national poll released on 03/Oct, the pollster's sixth round, registration BR-00198/2026, 5,000 participants recruited online between 30/Sep and 03/Oct, non-probability sample calibrated with IBGE data, the second round of 2022 and the TSE party membership registry, maximum margin of 2.4pp at 95% confidence (Exame). ⭐ IN THE FIRST ROUND FLÁVIO BOLSONARO HAS 47% AND LULA 43%, after 44% to 44% in the pollster's round of 29/Sep, with Renan Santos at 7%, Augusto Cury and Ronaldo Caiado at 1% and Romeu Zema below 1%. ⚖️ IN THE SECOND ROUND FLÁVIO BOLSONARO HAS 49% AND LULA 44%, after 47% to 45% on 29/Sep. Lula beats Augusto Cury by 44% to 36%, Renan Santos by 44% to 33%, Romeu Zema by 44% to 42% and Ronaldo Caiado by 43% to 42%.

AtlasIntel national poll released on the night of 03/Oct (Exame, 22h00 BRT), commissioned by Bloomberg, registration BR-00999/2026, 4,945 voters through random digital recruitment between 27/Sep and 02/Oct, margin of 1pp with 95% confidence. ⭐ IN TOTAL FIRST-ROUND VOTES LULA HAS 46.7% AND FLÁVIO BOLSONARO 43.8%, after 45.3% to 42.2% in the pollster's 29/Sep round, with Renan Santos at 4.6%, Augusto Cury at 2.1% and Ronaldo Caiado at 1.4%. In valid votes, Lula 47% and Flávio Bolsonaro 44.1%. ⚖️ IN THE SECOND ROUND LULA HAS 47.6% AND FLÁVIO BOLSONARO 47.4% in total votes, and 50.1% to 49.9% in valid votes, after 47.7% to 47.6% for Flávio Bolsonaro on 29/Sep.

Gerp's second national poll released on 03/Oct, registration BR-08168/2026, 2,400 voters by phone between 01 and 03/Oct, margin of 2pp (Jovem Pan). The pollster reports that the measurements of 2 and 3/Oct share part of the interviews with round BR-00509/2026. ⭐ IN THE FIRST ROUND FLÁVIO BOLSONARO HAS 44% AND LULA 42%, after 43% to 41% in the previous measurement, with Ronaldo Caiado at 4%, Augusto Cury at 3%, Renan Santos at 2% and Romeu Zema at 1%. In valid votes, Flávio Bolsonaro 45% and Lula 43%. This round's second-round numbers were not checked in the body and stay out.

Datafolha national poll released on 03/Oct, registration BR-01708/2026, 4,006 voters aged 16 or older interviewed on 03/Oct, margin of 2pp at 95% confidence (Money Times and Valor). ⭐ IN THE FIRST ROUND LULA HAS 42% AND FLÁVIO BOLSONARO 40%, after 42% to 38% in the pollster's round released on 01/Oct, with Ronaldo Caiado at 4%, Renan Santos and Augusto Cury at 3% and Romeu Zema below 1%; blank, null and none total 4% and undecided 3%. In valid votes, Lula 45% and Flávio Bolsonaro 42%. ⚖️ IN THE SECOND ROUND LULA HAS 47% AND FLÁVIO BOLSONARO 46%, after 48% to 45% on 01/Oct.

PoderData/Aya national poll released on 03/Oct, registration BR-03519/2026, 4,000 voters aged 16 or older in 786 municipalities across the 27 federative units, between 30/Sep and 02/Oct, margin of 1.5pp at 95% confidence (SBT News and Gazeta do Povo). ⭐ IN THE FIRST ROUND LULA HAS 42% AND FLÁVIO BOLSONARO 41%, after 41% to 39% in the pollster's round of 24/Sep, with Augusto Cury and Renan Santos at 3%, Ronaldo Caiado at 2% and Romeu Zema at 1%; blank and null total 4%. In valid votes, Lula 45% and Flávio Bolsonaro 43%. ⚖️ IN THE SECOND ROUND THE TWO TIE AT 46%, after 46% to 45% for Flávio Bolsonaro on 24/Sep.

Quaest national poll released on 03/Oct, registration BR-02197/2026, 3,702 voters interviewed in person on 02 and 03/Oct, margin of 2pp at 95% confidence (Money Times). ⭐ IN THE FIRST ROUND LULA HAS 40% AND FLÁVIO BOLSONARO 38%, after 39% to 34% in the pollster's round of 28/Sep, with Augusto Cury, Ronaldo Caiado and Renan Santos at 3%; blank, null and those who will not vote total 10% and undecided 3%. In valid votes, Lula 46% and Flávio Bolsonaro 45%. ⚖️ IN THE SECOND ROUND FLÁVIO BOLSONARO HAS 44% AND LULA 42%, after a tie at 42% on 28/Sep. 44% approve and 49% disapprove of the Lula government.

CNT/MDA national poll released on 03/Oct, registration BR-04756/2026, 2,007 in-person interviews, margin of 2.2pp at 95% confidence, cost of R$ 222,453.00 from the pollster's own funds (Poder360). The TSE registry lists fieldwork from 29/Sep to 02/Oct and the report says 30/Sep to 02/Oct. ⭐ IN THE FIRST ROUND LULA HAS 43.1% AND FLÁVIO BOLSONARO 38%, after 40.5% to 30.4% in the pollster's round of 15/Sep, with Augusto Cury at 3.2%, Ronaldo Caiado at 3%, Renan Santos at 1.5% and Romeu Zema at 0.8%; blank and null total 5%. In valid votes, Lula 47.8% and Flávio Bolsonaro 42.1%. ⚖️ IN THE SECOND ROUND LULA HAS 47.3% AND FLÁVIO BOLSONARO 43.1%, after 47.3% to 40% on 15/Sep.

Gerp national poll released on 03/Oct, registration BR-00509/2026, 2,400 voters interviewed by phone between 30/Sep and 02/Oct, margin of 2pp, cost of R$ 20,000 from the pollster's own funds (Poder360). The TSE registry lists the release on 29/Sep, before the fieldwork. ⭐ IN THE FIRST ROUND FLÁVIO BOLSONARO HAS 43% AND LULA 41%, after 42% to 40% in the pollster's round released on 29/Sep, with Augusto Cury at 4%, Ronaldo Caiado at 3% and Renan Santos at 2%. In valid votes, Flávio Bolsonaro 46% and Lula 44%. ⚖️ IN THE SECOND ROUND FLÁVIO BOLSONARO HAS 49% AND LULA 44%, after 50% to 43% on 29/Sep.

Futura/100% Cidades national poll released on 03/Oct, registration BR-02431/2026, 2,000 interviews, margin of 2.2pp at 95% confidence (Money Times). The TSE registry lists fieldwork from 29/Sep to 03/Oct and the report says 02 and 03/Oct. ⭐ IN THE FIRST ROUND FLÁVIO BOLSONARO HAS 42.5% AND LULA 40.5%, after 42.2% to 39.4% in the pollster's round of 30/Sep, with Augusto Cury at 3.9%, Ronaldo Caiado at 3.7%, Renan Santos at 2.6% and Romeu Zema at 0.8%. ⚖️ IN THE SECOND ROUND FLÁVIO BOLSONARO HAS 48% AND LULA 45.1%, after 49% to 43.5% on 30/Sep.

Vox Brasil national poll released on 02/Oct, registration BR-00148/2026, 2,100 voters interviewed face to face between 29/Sep and 01/Oct, margin of 2.15pp with 95% confidence, conducted with the institute's own funds (BNews SP, OCP News and GP1). ⭐ IN THE FIRST ROUND FLÁVIO BOLSONARO HAS 41.2% AND LULA 40.4%, within the margin, after Lula led by 41.1% to 37.8% in the pollster's round released on 29/Sep, with Ronaldo Caiado at 3.3%, Renan Santos at 2.2%, Romeu Zema at 1.3% and Augusto Cury at 1.2%; blank, null and none add up to 3.2% and 7% did not know. ⚖️ IN THE SECOND ROUND FLÁVIO BOLSONARO HAS 48.2% AND LULA 45.2%, within the margin, after 45.2% to 44.7% for him on 29/Sep. Lula wins the other two pairings tested: 46.3% to 42.1% against Ronaldo Caiado and 46.8% to 33.1% against Augusto Cury.

National Datafolha poll released on 01/Oct at 19h, registration BR-08039/2026, 2,506 interviews from 28/Sep to 01/Oct, margin of 2pp (CartaCapital, Metrópoles and VEJA). It is the pollster's second-to-last round before the first round; the last one is registered for 03/Oct. ⭐ IN THE FIRST ROUND LULA HAS 42% AND FLÁVIO BOLSONARO 38%, both 2 points above the 24/Sep round, which measured 40% to 36%, with Augusto Cury at 4%, Ronaldo Caiado and Renan Santos at 3% each and Romeu Zema at 1%. In valid votes, Lula has 45% and Flávio Bolsonaro 40%, according to Folha de S.Paulo. ⚖️ IN THE SECOND ROUND LULA HAS 48% AND FLÁVIO BOLSONARO 45%, after 47% to 45% on 24/Sep, within the margin. Lula wins the other four pairings tested: 48% to 42% against Ronaldo Caiado, 47% to 42% against Augusto Cury, 49% to 40% against Romeu Zema and 48% to 39% against Renan Santos. Government approval, according to O Globo: 48% against 49% disapproval.

National Real Time Big Data poll released on 01/Oct, registration BR-09503/2026, 2,000 telephone interviews with human interviewers from 26 to 30/Sep, margin of 2pp at 95% confidence, commissioned by the institute itself (Exame, UOL and Brasil de Fato). 🏷️ This pollster's sampling plan says "national" in its state polls too, so the label was checked against the release: the poll includes breakdowns for the Northeast, the South and the Center-West, which only exist in a national sample. ⭐ IN THE FIRST ROUND LULA HAS 43% AND FLÁVIO BOLSONARO 39%, against 41% to 37% in the pollster's 24/Sep round, with Renan Santos at 4%, Augusto Cury and Ronaldo Caiado at 3% each and Romeu Zema at 1%. ⚖️ IN THE SECOND ROUND FLÁVIO BOLSONARO HAS 46% AND LULA 45%, within the margin, after 45% to 44% for him on 24/Sep. Against Ronaldo Caiado Lula has 45% to 43%, against Augusto Cury 45% to 44% and against Romeu Zema 45% to 40%. 🚫 Rejection: Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro at 49% each, Renan Santos at 43%. Government approval: 46% against 52%.

Futura Inteligência with 100% Cidades, national poll released on 30/Sep, registration BR-01122/2026, 2,000 computer-assisted telephone interviews, margin of 2.2pp at 95% confidence (Rádio Itatiaia and Exame). 🏷️ Rádio Itatiaia and Exame give fieldwork from 25 to 29/Sep and the TSE registration declares 24 to 29/Sep; the panel keeps the registration's dates and declares the difference. ⭐ IN THE FIRST ROUND FLÁVIO BOLSONARO HAS 42.2% AND LULA 39.4%, against 40.4% to 38.4% in the 24/Sep round, with Ronaldo Caiado at 4%, Augusto Cury at 3.8%, Renan Santos at 3.2% and Romeu Zema at 1.6%. ⚖️ IN THE SECOND ROUND FLÁVIO BOLSONARO HAS 49% AND LULA 43.5%, the only distance outside the margin among the national polls of 30/Sep and 01/Oct. It is also the only pollster among them in which Lula loses to Ronaldo Caiado, by 42.4% to 45.6%, and to Augusto Cury, by 42% to 45.1%; against Romeu Zema he has 45.1% to 42.2% and against Renan Santos 44.6% to 40.7%. 🚫 Rejection: 48.9% for Lula and 45.6% for Flávio Bolsonaro. Government approval: 44.1% against 52.8%.

Ideia for Canal Meio, national poll released on 30/Sep, registration BR-08706/2026, 2,000 interviews from 25 to 28/Sep, margin of 2.2pp at 95% confidence (Gazeta do Povo and Folha de S.Paulo). ⭐ IN THE FIRST ROUND LULA HAS 39.4% AND FLÁVIO BOLSONARO 38.4%, within the margin, with Augusto Cury at 6.7%, Renan Santos at 4.5%, Ronaldo Caiado at 4.4% and Romeu Zema at 3.5%. In the spontaneous question, Lula has 31.5%, Flávio Bolsonaro 30.5% and 17.5% do not know. ⚖️ IN THE SECOND ROUND LULA HAS 48.5% AND FLÁVIO BOLSONARO 48%, after a tie at 46% in the 09/Sep round. Approval, according to CNN Brasil: 49% against 49%.

Indexa for Broadcast, from Agência Estado, national poll released on 30/Sep, registration BR-00698/2026, 2,000 interviews from 27 to 29/Sep, margin of 2.2pp at 95% confidence (Gazeta do Povo and CNN Brasil). ⭐ IN THE FIRST ROUND LULA HAS 39% AND FLÁVIO BOLSONARO 34%, against 38% to 34% in the 15/Sep round, with Ronaldo Caiado and Augusto Cury at 4% each, Renan Santos at 3% and Romeu Zema at 1%. ⚖️ IN THE SECOND ROUND LULA HAS 43% AND FLÁVIO BOLSONARO 42%, the same score as on 15/Sep, within the margin. Government approval: 46% against 51% disapproval.

AtlasIntel national poll in partnership with Bloomberg released on 29/Sep, TSE registration BR-04391/2026, 5,005 interviews by random digital recruitment between 23 and 28/Sep, margin of 1.0pp at 95% confidence (Sul 21, Panorama da Bahia, JOTA and Diário de Goiás). ⭐ IN THE FIRST ROUND LULA HAS 45.3% AND FLÁVIO BOLSONARO 42.2%, with Renan Santos at 5.2%, Augusto Cury at 2.0%, Ronaldo Caiado at 1.8% and Romeu Zema at 0.9%. Against the pollster's 23/Sep round, which measured 45.8% to 43.4%, both slip, and the distance widens from 2.4 to 3.1 points. 🥉 Renan Santos is third, with more than Cury, Caiado and Zema combined. ⚖️ IN THE SECOND ROUND FLÁVIO BOLSONARO HAS 47.7% AND LULA 47.6%, after Lula led by 47.7% to 47.4% on 23/Sep; both readings are within the margin. Against Ronaldo Caiado, Lula has 45.9% to 43.4%, and against Renan Santos the opponent has 28.9%. Lula approval: 45.2% against 53.6% disapproval.

Palver national poll released on 29/Sep, registration BR-02990/2026, 5,000 interviews by online questionnaire, margin of 2.4pp at 95% confidence, funded by the institute itself (Correio Braziliense, Estado de Minas and JOTA). 🏷️ Correio Braziliense gives fieldwork from 24 to 27/Sep and the TSE registration declares 24 to 28/Sep; the panel keeps the registration's dates and declares the difference. ⭐ IN THE FIRST ROUND LULA AND FLÁVIO BOLSONARO TIE AT 44%, with Renan Santos at 8% and Augusto Cury, Ronaldo Caiado and Romeu Zema at 1% each. In the 24/Sep round the tie was at 43%. ⚖️ IN THE SECOND ROUND FLÁVIO BOLSONARO HAS 47% AND LULA 45%, after 48% to 45% on 24/Sep, within the margin. 🚫 Rejection: 51% would not vote for Lula under any circumstances and 48% for Flávio Bolsonaro; Romeu Zema has 34%, Renan Santos 33%, Ronaldo Caiado 30% and Augusto Cury 28%.

Gerp national poll released on 29/Sep, registration BR-03929/2026, which the TSE listed for release on 27/Sep, 2,400 interviews by telephone, margin of 2.0pp with a 95.55% confidence interval, conducted with the institute's own funds (CNN Brasil, Exame and GP1). 🏷️ CNN Brasil and Exame give fieldwork from 24 to 28/Sep and the TSE registration declares 23 to 26/Sep; the panel keeps the registration's dates and declares the difference. ⭐ IN THE FIRST ROUND FLÁVIO BOLSONARO HAS 42% AND LULA 40%, with Augusto Cury at 5%, Ronaldo Caiado and Renan Santos at 3% each and Romeu Zema and Samara Martins at 1% each. Against the pollster's previous round, Lula rises from 37% to 40% and Flávio Bolsonaro from 40% to 42%. ⚖️ IN THE SECOND ROUND FLÁVIO BOLSONARO HAS 50% AND LULA 43%, the widest distance among the national polls of 28 and 29/Sep, and the only one outside the poll's own margin. 🚫 Rejection, with multiple answers: 50% for Lula and 42% for Flávio Bolsonaro. Government approval: 44% against 51%.

Vox Brasil national poll released on 29/Sep, registration BR-00895/2026, 2,100 voters in in-person household interviews between 26 and 28/Sep, margin of 2.15pp at 95% confidence, commissioned by the institute itself (Exame, Metrópoles, CNN Brasil and Portal N10). ⭐ IN THE FIRST ROUND LULA HAS 41.1% AND FLÁVIO BOLSONARO 37.8%, with Ronaldo Caiado at 3.8%, Renan Santos at 2.7%, Augusto Cury at 2.2% and Romeu Zema at 1.8%. ⚖️ IN THE SECOND ROUND FLÁVIO BOLSONARO HAS 45.2% AND LULA 44.7%, within the margin, with 6.8% blank, null or none and 3.3% no answer. Lula wins the other three pairings tested: 45.3% to 41.1% against Ronaldo Caiado, 44.8% to 35.1% against Augusto Cury and 46.1% to 30.3% against Romeu Zema.

National Quaest poll released on 28/Sep, TSE registration BR-06520/2026, 2,004 voters interviewed in person from Thursday to Sunday, 24 to 27/Sep, margin of 2.0pp at 95% confidence, commissioned by Grupo Globo (O Globo, G1, CartaCapital and CNN Brasil).
